description: Pull requests, review comments, pipelines, work items and publishing for Azure DevOps. Inactive until you sign in.

azureDevOps.serverUrl.description: The Azure DevOps server: https://dev.azure.com, or an Azure DevOps Server's address without the collection (https://tfs.contoso.com/tfs). Set when you sign in from a repository whose remote is on an Azure DevOps Server.

azureDevOps.authorityUrl.description: The Microsoft Entra ID authority for signing in with a device code.

azureDevOps.profileUrl.description: The Azure DevOps profile service (who is signed in, their organizations).

azureDevOps.oauthClientId.description: The client id of the Microsoft Entra ID app used to sign in with a device code. The default is Codalus IDE's app, for Azure DevOps Services (dev.azure.com). An Azure DevOps Server signs in with your Windows account or a token instead. Empty: sign in with a personal access token.
